text:
zoe: noticing a spike of WS 1006 closes from a few customers after last night's edge push. root cause looks like the proxy emitting many sub-50 byte frames; client libs reconnect immediately and we see double billing traces.

ben: is this only websocket? any SSE reports?

zoe: mostly WS but a couple SSE streams show partial event boundaries. route: /v1/stream/respond (ap-south).

tara: can you paste one proxy hex snippet?

zoe: snippet: 7b22 69 64 22 3a 22 61 22 7d ("{\"id\":\"a\"}") sent across multiple tiny writes.

ben: hypothesis: http2 -> ws adapter is flushing aggressively. options: disable aggressive flush, or coalesce small writes in proxy.

tara: coalescing seems safest but add guardrails: feature flag + per-route opt-out + metrics. We should tag frames <64B as small_frame for filtering.

metrics-bot: created metrics: stream.small_frame_count, stream.reconnect_rate, stream.coalesce_latency_ms (route + tenant labels).

zoe: quick staging test with coalescing (buffer up to 60B or 40ms) reduced reconnects from 14/min -> 2/min. p95 latency +9ms.

ben: OK gate behind rollout flag and console card: "Stream anomalies" showing tiny-frame spikes and reconnect loops. Tara please add CLI toggle for fast rollback.

tara: will open PR and add rollout plan. will avoid logging payloads (hash+len only).

zoe: staging hold for 2h, will update. thanks. :thumbsup:
